column1: # Serial fixes: discs whose IP.BIN product code clashes with another game's, matched on the product and
# the release date (or a word of the title). openMenu fixes these at boot (backend/gd_list.c,
# fix_sega_serials) and the Virtual Folder Bundle's card manager does the same (its "Table 1"), so the
# card must use the fixed code everywhere or art and edits never match on the console.
# Columns: product, date, title contains, fixed product, title
